title: ever FAYE|Plus Size V-Neck Pleated Chiffon Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Designed to flatter curves, this plus size dress features a softly pleated bodice, feminine V-neckline, and airy flutter sleeves for comfortable coverage. The flowy chiffon skirt with a high-low hem adds movement and elegance, making it a versatile choice for weddings, special occasions, or formal gatherings.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
